title: MDX Quetzal set audit - P3 corrections (extraction integration build, 2026-11-23; bench round 1 corrections applied by integration build 2, 2026-11-23)
provenance: Moemon sprites extracted from MoemonQuetzalEnglishAlpha8v4 (Moemon Project); original art by Moemon Project artists (Western roster per Neon's gap report: McMagister, Cornbread, BlizzWhite, toot, Kiri, Arez Vii, RED, Orange, TKMO, ZX2019, Nerak55, Master Rumi, fuwu, Rache, Cookie, Manor, ArmoredCat, Infinity X, Kurisu, Mars, MAGNEMITEY, LeBinPasta, Jackpot, Kana, Queso, LK, Stardust Hurricane).

sources.inventory_csv: MOEMON_QUETZAL_1520_SLOT_INVENTORY.csv (ROM pointers + uniqueness flags, Neon extraction)

notes: Shared pointers are NEVER shared across species (0 cross-species groups, front and back): every shared group is a same-species form family (Arceus plates, Deerling seasons, Genesect drives, Flabebe/Floette/Florges colours, ...). CORRECTED by bench round 1 (applied here): Neon's v2 inventory flagged the canonical slot of all 48 shared groups is_shared=false, so flag-filtered counts read 126 front / 130 back; every slot of a shared group now carries front_ptr_shared / back_ptr_shared = true with front_canonical_slot / back_canonical_slot naming the group's lowest slot, and the flag-filtered counts read the true 148 front / 156 back. Unique pointer totals are unchanged (1,393 front / 1,389 back).
Slot 1378 (Pecharunt) is the confirmed standard-Pokemon fallback (Neon visual spot-check). Its ROM pointers are unique - uniqueness does not clear a slot of fallback status.

Slots 1381-1434 (late Gen 9 DLC block): only 6 of 54 front pointers are unique - the fallback-suspect block. Listed in the residue file for per-slot visual audit against the Moemon Project Sprite Database naming map.

Form names for the 449 form slots: RESOLVED IN PART by bench round 1 (in-house, 2026-11-23) and applied here by integration build 2. 365 of 449 slots now carry a real form name in form_name (263 grounded by bench round 1 in the project's own Showdown variant lists, validated on 48 named anchors; 102 carried from Neon's inventory v2 descriptors). 84 slots keep an honest placeholder (form_name null, form_name_status placeholder_kept_bench_round1) with the recorded reason in form_name_reason -- cosmetic families the export does not enumerate (Unown, Minior, Furfrou, Alcremie, Floette family, ...) and species whose ROM slot count differs from the Showdown variant count, where an ordinal mapping cannot be proven. No name was invented.
Quetzal PNG files are not on this machine; slots without a MoeMMO cross-check copy are archive-only until Neon ships the extracted PNGs (or the pointers above are re-extracted from the ROM).
